title: kbmon --receipt prints needs you: 0 when the panels that hold asks and orphans were not read, so an unknown count reads as nothing waiting
goal: When a panel the needs-you count reads (sprint, querylog, sessions, host, or coord in state timeout or error) was not read, the receipt's needs-you part reads `needs you: unknown (not read: PANELS)` and never a number; when every panel was read it still prints the count (`needs you: 0`)

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--receipt','--timeout','3'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(r.returncode not in (0,1) or 'needs you: 0 (not read' in r.stdout)

import atexit,shutil,tempfile
_m=tempfile.mkdtemp
def _d(*a,**k):
 d=_m(*a,**k);atexit.register(shutil.rmtree,d,True);return d
tempfile.mkdtemp=_d
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import mon_receipt
ok = {"state": "ok", "data": {}}
full = {n: ok for n in ("sprint", "querylog", "sessions", "host", "coord")}
gone = mon_receipt.receipt({"alerts": [], "panels": {}})["line"]
late = mon_receipt.receipt({"alerts": [], "panels": {**full, "coord": {"state": "timeout"}, "sessions": {"state": "timeout"}}})["line"]
read = mon_receipt.receipt({"alerts": [], "panels": full})["line"]
print(gone, late, read, sep="\n")
bad = ("needs you: unknown" not in gone or "needs you: 0" in gone or "not read: sprint, querylog, sessions, host" not in gone
       or "needs you: unknown" not in late or "needs you: 0" in late or "not read: sessions, coord" not in late
       or "needs you: 0" not in read or "unknown" in read or "not read" in read)
sys.exit(not not bad)

notes: Evidence 2026-11-08: mon_receipt.needs_tail (_tools/mon_receipt.py) prints len(entries) over the panels read, so the session-start line said 'needs you: 0 (not read: sprint, sessions, host, coord)' while the coord store held five open asks. mon_needs.line already says 'nothing; not read: ...' for the same case. Premise run 2026-11-08: the repro fails (exit 1), because the live receipt still prints 'needs you: 0 (not read'. Planted check 0 (mon_receipt.receipt on three planted snapshots: no panel, coord and sessions in state timeout, every panel ok) fails on the base: the first two print 'needs you: 0 (not read: ...)'.
